description: Delivers Extreme Performance: It is built to resist overheating and wear during extended use, ensuring dependable operation even under heavy loads. The upgraded 2,300 W motor greatly enhances the cutting speed and efficiency, the fast clamp allows for smoother and cleaner cut outs. Adjustable Spark Guard with Ergonomic Design: It is designed to improve user safety by directing sparks away from the operator, reducing the risk of any hazard. The ergonomically designed D-Handle provides comfort and ease of use for both left- and right-handed individuals. Metal foot design is a robust component that endures the high temperatures generated during cutting, it will not melt or warp under pressure. The spindle lock in a chop saw is a safety feature that secures the spindle in place, allowing for easy and safe blade changes. Speed & Rated Power: The BOSCH GCO 230 ELECTRIC CHOP SAW offers a powerful motor of 2300 W and an impressive speed of 0-4100 RPM, making it suitable for various tasks such as metal & rebar cutting applications. Its robust performance ensures fast and accurate results, particularly when used with specific cutting wheels. This flexibility enables users to handle light and challenging tasks with ease. Cutting Capacity: These specifications highlight the versatility of the BOSCH GCO 230 ELECTRIC CHOP SAW in handling various shapes and sizes of metal materials, making it suitable for a range of cutting tasks. Cutting capacity rectangle 100 × 200 mm, cutting capacity square 120 × 120 mm, Cutting capacity L-profile 137 × 137 mm at 0 degree. Application: The Corded Electric Chop Saw is specifically created for temporary structure builders, construction experts, and factory workers. It provides accurate and efficient metal cutting for a wide range of uses such as rebar and steel pipes, improving productivity and guaranteeing high-quality outcomes at the worksite. Scope of Supply: The package comes with a corded electric chop saw, cutting disc and an allen wrench that is tailored to enhance its functionality. This cutting disc is perfect for a range of steel and metal. Warranty: The Warranty of this product is valid for 1 year from the invoice date (invoice copy needed for claims) by the brand.
